option_statement: Run a two week volunteer survey that marks every dark light on a shared sheet.
mechanism: Volunteers walk set sections after dusk and record each unlit pole by number.
authority_and_legal_basis: Public road walking needs no permit, and pole numbers are public asset data in Lowmere.

how_it_meets_stage_criteria.how: Every pole on the ring road has a recorded status after the second week.

risks_and_rights_impact: Walkers may be mistaken for loiterers after dark. Walk in pairs and carry a team card.
lawful_alternatives: Ask the council to share its own inspection list.
